title: Associator constraint for normalized ringed tensor comparison on flat-term K-flat representatives
statement:
Let J,R and J',R' be small ringed sites with independently sized coefficients, U an additive exact functor between their module-sheaf categories preserving the products and K-injectives needed for its derived functor, and u coherent underived tensor/Hom comparison data [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. Fix closed derived tensor presentations SB,TB,betaB,cB and SA,TA,betaA,cA [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Suppose termwise U preserves flat-term K-flat complexes; give a natural total-tensor comparison chain with the specified underived tensor map on every coproduct summand, and give a derived natural isomorphism mu satisfying the representative square on flat-term K-flat pairs. For every three flat-term K-flat complexes $P,Q,N$, put $X=\mathsf Q(P)$, $Y=\mathsf Q(Q)$ and $Z=\mathsf Q(N)$, where $\mathsf Q$ is localization to the derived category, and put $F=U_D$. Then
$$
 (1\otimes\mu_{Y,Z})\circ\mu_{X,Y\otimes Z}\circ F(\alpha^B_{X,Y,Z})
 =\alpha^A_{FX,FY,FZ}\circ(\mu_{X,Y}\otimes1)\circ\mu_{X\otimes Y,Z}.
$$
This is only the associator equation at these three localized representatives; no unit or symmetry assertion or extension to arbitrary derived objects is part of the statement.

proof.text: The sheafification adjunction detects equality of maps out of the iterated sheaf tensor on all local pure triples. Tensor the inner sheafification unit with the third factor; its sheafification is invertible because tensor preserves local equivalences. Cancel this isomorphism and the two tensor/sheafification isomorphisms, then use the adjunction and sectionwise tensor extensionality. Naturality of the unit and moduleTmul_map give the required evaluation formula. Applying this criterion on each triple coproduct summand identifies the associator_model witnesses with the native complex associators, using complexConstraints.associator. The proved ringed model-square theorem combines this identification with the summand-normalized chain associativity calculation.

The two inner source total tensors are K-flat and have flat terms by kFlat_total_tensor_model. Apply hU to them and to P,Q,N. Apply the representative square to the two inner pairs and both outer pairs. Naturality of mu combines these four squares into the left and right triple normalization equations; naturality of the target tensor models moves the inner chain comparison through each outer model. Rewrite tensorIso by T.iso using tensorIso_both. The two associator_model equations and naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors then turn the localized chain square into the desired derived square. Cancel the image of the left triple model isomorphism and the tensor of the three factorization isomorphisms.

from.place: The associator check on representative complexes in steps 2–3 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-coherence, below the tensor comparison descent step.

lean.statement:
theorem ringed_forget_tensor_associator_representatives
    (hU : ∀ P : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ,
      P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
      (∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r}
        (R := R) (P.X p)) →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R')
        ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{d, vd, max d vd s, max d vd s}
        (R := R') (U.obj (P.X p)))
    (chain : coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{s, d, vd} J' R')
    (summand : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
      U.map (tensorSummand.{c, v, r} J R P Q p q n hpq) ≫ (chain.hom.app (P, Q)).f n =
        u.tensor.hom.app (P.X p, Q.X q) ≫
          tensorSummand.{d, vd, s} J' R' ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n hpq)
    (μ : SB.tensor ⋙ U.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (U.mapDerivedCategory.prod U.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ SA.tensor)
    (hμ : RepresentativeModel.{c, v, r, d, vd, s, wb, wa}
      J R J' R' U SB TB SA TA chain μ.hom)
    (P Q N : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (fP : ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r}
      (R := R) (P.X p))
    (hQ : Q.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (fQ : ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r}
      (R := R) (Q.X p))
    (hN : N.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (fN : ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r}
      (R := R) (N.X p)) :
    U.mapDerivedCategory.map (SB.monoidal.associator (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)).hom ≫
        μ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P,
          SB.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) ≫
        SA.tensor.map
          (X := (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
            U.mapDerivedCategory.obj
              (SB.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj N))))
          (Y := (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
            SA.tensor.obj (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q),
              U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N))))
          (𝟙 _, μ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) =
      μ.hom.app (SB.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q),
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
        SA.tensor.map
          (X := (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (SB.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)),
              U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)))
          (Y := (SA.tensor.obj (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
            U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)),
              U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)))
          (μ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q), 𝟙 _) ≫
        (SA.monoidal.associator (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
          (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q))
          (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N))).hom
